# Joshua Tree Moon Calendar

> Moon Calendar 2027, Joshua Tree Edition. Fourteen desert moons by Katherine Dale and Heather Vescent. A monthly calendar that notes the moon cycle from December 2026 through January 2028.

Heather sent photos of desert moons to Katherine in the city. Katherine printed these monotypes on her printing press.

## Moon names

- December 2026: Pocket Mouse
- January 2027: Red Barrel
- February 2027: Granite
- March 2027: Pear Blossom
- April 2027: California Poppy
- May 2027: Gambel Quail
- June 2027: Hummingbird
- July 2027: Beaver Tail
- August 2027: Coyote
- September 2027: Date Palm
- October 2027: Gopher Snake
- November 2027: Joshua Tree
- December 2027: Big Horn Sheep
- January 2028: Basin

- [Heather Vescent](https://www.instagram.com/heathervescent/): photographs desert moons from her geodesic dome in the Mojave Desert
